item.name: 06 Known issues
item.description: Each request here shows a defect described in docs/findings.md. The spec-correct expectation is kept as a skipped "Known issue TS-NN" test so it is visible in every report.

item.name: Brands can be created without logging in

exec: pm.test.skip('Known issue TS-01: creating a brand requires a login', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));
// The API accepted it, so the admin removes the brand again
(err, res) => pm.test('Clean-up: brand deleted by admin', () => pm.expect(res.code).to.eql(204)));
